localizedPages.about: The Rainbow Hub is a lightweight quiz site for fast, mobile-friendly reasoning, trivia, and knowledge challenges.
localizedPages.contact: For questions about quizzes, privacy, accessibility, or site issues, use the Contact page.
localizedPages.accessibility: We aim to keep pages readable, navigable, and usable across common devices. Please contact us if you find an accessibility issue.
localizedPages.privacyPolicy: The Privacy Policy explains what information may be collected, why it is used, how it may be shared, and the choices visitors may have.
localizedPages.cookiePolicy: The Cookie Policy explains how cookies, pixels, local storage, and similar technologies may support site functionality, analytics, advertising, and rewarded ad flows.
localizedPages.termsOfUse: The Terms of Use explain the rules for using The Rainbow Hub, including quiz limitations, advertising, intellectual property, disclaimers, and liability.

quizFooter.howItWorksBody: The challenge unfolds across multiple stages. Early rounds focus on accessible questions and quick decisions, while later stages may introduce more complex ideas, changing patterns, careful comparisons, or unfamiliar scenarios. Each stage builds on the last, encouraging focus, attention to detail, adaptability, and confident decision-making.
quizFooter.whatThisTestsBody: Rather than focusing on a single topic, this challenge explores a range of skills, preferences, and ways of thinking that may be relevant across different situations:
testBullets: Adapting to new questions and scenarios
quizFooter.scoringBody: Questions may include explanations, insights, or additional context as you progress. Scores and outcomes are intended as a fun benchmark for self-discovery, challenge, and comparison, not as a scientific, academic, professional, or official assessment. There is no universal pass or fail score. Each challenge is designed to provide an engaging experience from start to finish.
quizFooter.passFailNotice: There is no universal pass or fail score. Each challenge is designed to provide an engaging experience from start to finish.
quizFooter.restartNote: Your progress will be cleared and the challenge will restart.
